summary: Northwest Natural Gas Company, a subsidiary of Northwest Natural Holding Company, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report a Washington Utilities and Transportation Commission order approving a rate case settlement. The order grants revenue increases of $20.1 million in Year 1 (starting August 2026), $7.5 million in Year 2, and $7.4 million in Year 3, with a 9.5% return on equity and 50/50 debt-equity capital structure. This is a regulatory rate decision, not a special situation, so no further action is anticipated.
